scope: Actual shared static body viewer only, isolated same-origin QA parent harness; not Sahara app integration, clinical validity, Play availability or physical Android runtime.
browser: Existing Chromium headless shell1243, software WebGL2/ANGLE SwiftShader, dedicated ephemeral Playwright CLI session sahara-pain-qa; one context at a time.
boundaries: Keyboard region controls and no-WebGL usable controls live outside the iframe in app wrappers and were not served or tested here. Root/web agent must verify their integration.
Native error bridge was simulated only to verify shared JS emits its actual error; no Android WebView or physical-device interaction is claimed.
Point state restoration was verified through the public viewer API and QA parent state, not clinical record persistence.
The deliberate no-WebGL failure produces the expected renderer console error; it emits parent/native error and instructs use of body-area buttons.
No production/authenticated Chrome profiles or Play Console were used.
